dialogues.speaker: Lixin
dialogues.text: Everyone is welcome to work with the Feiyun Commerce Guild! We are currently expanding, with new business ventures across a variety of industries!

dialogues.speaker: Lixin
dialogues.text: Oh? Are you a merchant too?

dialogues.speaker: Lixin
dialogues.text: The Feiyun Commerce Guild is currently exploring new business opportunities, including combining fabrics and jade, adding tea during the fabric-dyeing process to introduce new fragrances, and more!

dialogues.speaker: Lixin
dialogues.text: If you're interested in a business partnership, just talk to me and I'll faithfully inform the commerce guild of the specifics of your intentions!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Will the heir to your family come?

dialogues.speaker: Lixin
dialogues.text: About that... I am not entirely sure! I've been working here at Feiyun Commerce Guild for some time now, yet I still haven't laid eyes on Master Xingqiu!

dialogues.speaker: Lixin
dialogues.text: I heard that the old grounds of the Guhua Clan are somewhere in Chenyu Vale. Perhaps someday Master Xingqiu will come and visit, should the mood strike him!

dialogues.speaker: Lixin
dialogues.text: I've heard that Master Xingqiu is experienced beyond his years and his knowledge is vast. Perhaps after coming to Chenyu Vale, he'll have a stroke of genius or three and give us some great new ideas!

dialogues.speaker: Lixin
dialogues.text: Very well! I eagerly await the opportunity to formally begin our commercial collaboration!
